text: Name a chemical element found in the Sun’s atmosphere

facts.Hydrogen: Makes up about three-quarters of the Sun’s mass.
facts.Helium: Found in sunlight in 1868, decades before it was found on Earth, and named after Helios, the Greek sun god.
facts.Oxygen: The third most abundant element in the Sun, after hydrogen and helium.
facts.Iron: A green glow in the Sun’s corona was once blamed on a new element, “coronium”. It turned out to be highly ionised iron.
facts.Sodium: Makes the dark pair of D lines in the solar spectrum that Joseph von Fraunhofer catalogued in 1814.
facts.Calcium: Behind the strong H and K lines in sunlight, named by Fraunhofer.
